claims.claim: table_25 client/server members are independently selected by archive TOC and declared payload size
claims.method: Parse both FMF TOCs, bound table_25 by the next member, decode every zstd frame, and select the unique frame whose output length equals the TOC declaration.

claims.claim: The native 12-byte identity plus 9-byte footer closes exactly once on both archives.
claims.method: Scan all four byte alignments for ordinal|UID|UID, then count non-overlapping full tilings by ordinal with UID nonzero and strictly increasing; recover the sole path.

claims.claim: The 7,047 identity UIDs align client-to-server byte-for-byte as a data-side result independent of the reader cursor.
claims.method: Compare recovered ordinal and UID lanes, the concatenated 12-byte identity digest, and UID digest after two independent DP recoveries.

claims.claim: The footer is identical in both archives, byte-for-byte.
claims.method: Read the nine bytes after the recovered final identity and compare both payloads to the frozen byte string.

claims.claim: All 7,047 selector bytes are zero; server row byte sequences match the 25 t59 execution templates and counts.
claims.method: Parse only row bytes between recovered boundaries, record the first selector and each byte-grammar event in order, then compare the resulting sequence/count map to t59 field_slots.json; no CFG is rebuilt.

claims.claim: The t01f six-continent, parent-352, England, and China PR fixtures re-close on both row sets.
claims.method: Use recovered row ordinals and byte-grammar event coordinates to recheck the named t01f values, child parent ordinal, parent UID, and identity UID anchors.
